'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Tim Simon LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tim Simon]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Ghost Ride, Go Crazy! Starts [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear]]. Sheet IITFYS (V) → non-(V) objective. Master Qui-Gon both (V) and non-(V) as written.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tim Simon]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
